content: अर्बु(र्ब)दः, -दम् .²1 A swelling, tumour, (of various kind); मांस˚, नासा˚, शोणित˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 One hundred millions. बहूनीह सहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च . अशक्यान्येव संख्यातुं पन्नगानां तपोधन .. <ls>Mb. 1. 35. 19</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a mountain in the West of India (Abu). .²4 A serpent-like demon killed by Indra; <ls>Rv. 1. 51. 6</ls>. .²5 A serpent. .²6 A cloud. .²7 A place of pilgrimage (of the Jainas). .²8 A long round mass, lump of flesh; यदि पिण्डः पुमान् स्त्री चेत् पेशी नपुंसकं चेदर्बुदम् <ls>Suśr.</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 75</ls>, <ls n="Y. 3.">89</ls> (मांसपिण्ड). .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of a people. .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of a hell. .{@-आकारः@} <ab>N.</ab> of the plant Cordia myxa (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>गोंदणी, भोंकर</ns>).
